name: test-history
title: Unit test history
for_each: SELECT id,serial_number AS name FROM reports

sections.title: Recorded steps
sections.sql: SELECT path,name,status,measurements FROM steps WHERE report_id=$1

sections.title: Follow-up actions
sections.sql: SELECT title,owner,due,state,closure_evidence FROM actions WHERE report_id=$1

sections.title: Evidence notes
sections.sql: SELECT actor,body,created_at FROM notes WHERE report_id=$1
sections.note: Internal evidence packet. Not a certificate or authorisation to ship.

name: corrective-action
title: Corrective action record
for_each: SELECT id,title AS name FROM actions

sections.title: Action and closure
sections.note: Closure records follow-up work. It does not change the original test result.
